title: Section ring of the inverse-image affine open under scalar base change
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with an R-algebra structure on S, let f:X→Spec R be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and use the cartesian base change X_S and projections g,f_S of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Let W be an affine open of X, W\prime=g^{-1}W, and h:W\prime≤g^{-1}W. Put A=Γ(X,W), B=Γ(X_S,W\prime), α:R→A equal to the structure map followed by restriction to W, and β:S→B equal to the structure map of f_S followed by restriction to W\prime. Give A its R-algebra structure along α and B its A-algebra structure along g.appLE(W,W\prime,h). There exists an A-algebra equivalence e:A⊗_R S≃B satisfying e(1⊗b)=β(b) for every b∈S. No flatness, quasi-coherence, or nonemptiness is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 26.6.7, applied to the inverse-image affine open; also Tag 02KG, affine ring calculation in the proof of Lemma 30.5.1.

proof.text: Restrict the cartesian square to the open W: the inverse-image open W\prime is its pullback along W→X. Identify W with Spec A by its canonical affine-open isomorphism. Naturality of the structure map identifies W→Spec R with Spec α. The affine fibre-product isomorphism identifies W\prime with Spec(A⊗_R S). Its two projection formulas give the maps A→A⊗_R S and S→A⊗_R S.

Apply global sections to that scheme isomorphism and compose with the canonical Γ(Spec C)=C isomorphism. The A-projection formula proves this is an A-algebra equivalence; the S-projection formula says that it sends 1⊗b to β(b). For empty W the construction still works: A and B are zero rings.

proof_origin.place: Affine pullback formula, restricted to W, with global sections and the projection identities; Tag 02KG affine calculation.

lean.statement: theorem exists_baseChange_affine_sectionRing_tensor (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (W' : (baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).Opens) (hW' : W' = baseChangeFst (S := S) f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (h : W' ≤ baseChangeFst (S := S) f ⁻¹ᵁ W) : let α := ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op).hom).comp (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom) let β := (((baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W' ≤ ⊤)).op).hom).comp (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv ≫ (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f).appTop).hom) letI : Algebra R Γ(X, W) := α.toAlgebra letI : Algebra Γ(X, W) Γ(baseChangedScheme (S := S) f, W') := (baseChangeFst (S := S) f |>.appLE W W' h).hom.toAlgebra ∃ e : (Γ(X, W) ⊗[R] S) ≃ₐ[Γ(X, W)] Γ(baseChangedScheme (S := S) f, W'), ∀ b : S, e (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) = β b
